import django
from django.conf import settings
settings.configure(
    DEBUG=True,
    DATABASES={"default": {"ENGINE": "django.db.backends.sqlite3", "NAME": ":memory:"}},
    INSTALLED_APPS=["django.contrib.contenttypes", "django.contrib.auth"],
    MIGRATION_MODULES={"migrations": "migrations.test_migrations_squashed"},
    USE_TZ=True,
)
django.setup()
from django.db import connection
from django.db.migrations.executor import MigrationExecutor
from django.test.utils import setup_test_environment, get_runner
setup_test_environment()
old_name = connection.creation.create_test_db(verbosity=0, autoclobber=True)
try:
    executor = MigrationExecutor(connection)
    executor.migrate([("migrations", "0001_squashed_0002")])
    applied = executor.recorder.applied_migrations()
    assert ("migrations", "0001_squashed_0002") in applied, "squash not applied"
    print("applied after squash:", sorted(applied))
    # Now unapply everything (ticket scenario: squash + replaced files still on disk)
    executor.loader.build_graph()
    executor.migrate([("migrations", None)])
    applied = executor.recorder.applied_migrations()
    print("applied after unapply:", sorted(applied))
    assert ("migrations", "0001_squashed_0002") not in applied, \
        "BUG: squashed migration not marked unapplied"
    assert ("migrations", "0001_initial") not in applied
    assert ("migrations", "0002_second") not in applied
    print("OK: squashed migration correctly marked unapplied")
finally:
    connection.creation.destroy_test_db(old_name, verbosity=0)
EOF
